question: Do native responsibility and migration documents add source-supported placement constraints, exceptions or justified uncertainty to review of actual behavior and its type/module/crate location?
scope: One development pilot over at most six fixed real firmware units; no similarity-pair requirement
inputs: responsibility-input-audit-01 cards, admitted after independent source check; complete same-version relevant definitions and original document with migration qualifications
gate: Freeze exact card IDs, complete source regions, hashes and common task before outputs
Preserve direct delegation, document/status conflict, legitimate upper-layer or conditional migration case and explicit unknown if available; do not invent cases to balance labels
Separate historical normative statement, future plan, status report and actual source fact
No after design, researcher-authored owner, reference conclusion or evaluation table in model packets
output_fields: placement recommendation at type/mod/crate granularity or unknown
missing evidence and bounded next check
evaluation: Whether added information changes placement reasoning rather than merely vocabulary
reference_policy: Document/state contradiction is not a real responsibility violation. Genuine violation reference denominator may be zero; do not report recall or accuracy without appropriate independent labels. Current location is not normative oracle.
isolation: Fresh non-forked agents, no tool use requested, instruction-level only; not hard sandbox or equal inference budget
stop: After both full responses and claim-level source audit, close; no owner/exception/prompt retuning, no expanding cards to obtain favorable results
limits: No architectural optimality, split benefit, production refactor or novelty claim
review_basis: Goodall responsibility-design-01; principal accepts bounded conditional-review pilot, not architecture truth classification
